<div style="float:right; position:relative; width:200px; right: -40px;"> ![Hi there!](cover.svg) </div>

I'm Martin Chan, a Senior Data Scientist at Microsoft. I work at the intersection of people analytics, workplace collaboration, and AI adoption, with a focus on helping multinational organizations turn behavioral data into practical decisions.

My current work is centered on:

- Employee wellbeing and collaboration effectiveness
- Measuring the impact and return on investment of AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot
- Translating analytics into actionable recommendations for enterprise stakeholders

---

I also maintain open-source tooling for workplace analytics, including:

- [{vivainsights} (R)](https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights/) ([CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vivainsights))
- [vivainsights (Python)](https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/) ([PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/vivainsights/))
- [Viva Insights Sample Code](https://microsoft.github.io/viva-insights-sample-code/)

Alongside this, I continue to build and share practical R/Python projects and write about data science workflows.

To find out more, check out my [about page](https://martinctc.github.io/about), [portfolio](https://martinctc.github.io/portfolio), [blog](https://martinctc.github.io/blog), and [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/martin-chan-tc/).
